note: Lassen NF campground and picnic area on Hwy 32 along upper Deer Creek at the Elam Creek confluence, under tall conifers; most sites suit a small to medium RV. Deer Creek is stocked with trout in summer and has special fishing regulations. Parking for extra vehicles is very limited. --Claude
summary: Elam (Lassen NF): FS page + rec.gov search (none, first-come) + forest alerts + topo, imagery and 3DEP. $14, 15 sites, April-September, 14-night limit, 2 vehicles / 8 people, no potable water (current alert). Creekside not confirmable - downgrade lead. Pin ~190 m from the loops, kept.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade candidate, creekside -> not waterfront; reviewer decides): no qualifying source puts named pads at Deer Creek. Imagery is canopy-blind. The FS page has no per-site map and says only 'situated along Deer Creek'. The stored evidence ('sites within ~30-40m of the creek corridor') names no pads. The terrain would pass the creekside walk test: 3DEP puts the east loop (~40.2469,-121.4478) on a bench 1.8-2.8 m above the channel 20-60 m away, and the west-bank spur (~40.2478,-121.4485) 3 m above it 20-35 m away. But the west-bank sites line the spur road, which runs between most of them and the creek, and nothing shows which side the pads are on. Deer Creek is well under 30 m, so creekside is the right class if kept. Strict default-down gives not waterfront; keeping it needs a per-site artifact (camper photo, FS map).

FACILITIES: the FS current-conditions alert says 'Currently, no potable water is available at site' while the amenity line says 'Potable water is available at this site.' Kept potable_water false (the alert is the live statement).

SEASON: 'generally open April - September' -> 04-01..09-30. The page still says 'Site Open' (updated September 1, 2026); it is presumably closed for the season now, but nothing says so. status not written.
BOOKING: no rec.gov listing -> reservable false, platform none, fcfs always.
PHONE: stored 530-258-2141 = Almanor Ranger District on the FS page - keep. WEBSITE: stored FS page current - keep.
PIN: stored 40.24604,-121.44890 (= FS lat/long) is at the CA 32 bridge at the campground entrance; the loops lie ~100-280 m north (centre ~40.2477,-121.4484, ~190 m) - under 250 m, no move.
